lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and sequential vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of spots, forming a coordinate-like matrix where they cross the horizontal carinae and spot rows.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges on the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient, showing high-intensity reflection on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced low-intensity pixels on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, diffuse, high-luminance blobs scattered across the lower and middle regions of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark elongated pixel clusters (remoras) positioned near the ventral-lateral transition zone posterior to the pectoral fin.
